data_fields.name: npc start tile x and y
data_fields.donor_constant: read per slot from the town data (values not read)

data_fields.name: npc movement mode
data_fields.donor_constant: 0 fixed, 1 wander, 0x80 follow avatar, 0xFF attack avatar; other values fail the load

data_fields.name: role slot id
data_fields.donor_constant: 1-based slot index, no range check in donor

data_fields.name: dialogue id per npc
data_fields.donor_constant: index into the town text file, matched by slot number plus one

data_fields.name: companion skip rule
data_fields.donor_constant: skip when companion has joined the party (matched by name in donor)

best_idea: Author a town's services as a fixed roster of slots (tile, start, role, dialogue) and rebuild the population from it on every entry, skipping party members who have joined.
decision_why: The authored roster and rebuild-on-entry placement fit zones as data for hub services; key the companion skip by character id from the ledger and keep anger-style state in the ledger, not in the copy.
acceptance: Entering a test hub places exactly the authored vendor roles at their authored tiles; a companion who has joined the party is absent from the placed roster; a roster with a slot outside 1 to MAX, or a start on a blocked tile, fails zone load with an error.
